newsitem.title: SPAIN: Belgian PM pledges judicial cooperation with Spain.
newsitem.headline: Belgian PM pledges judicial cooperation with Spain.

text.p: Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene, on an official visit to Spain, on Monday said he was willing to help solve judicial problems between the two states.
"We are prepared to go very far," Dehaene said during a conference on the European Union (EU) attended by Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar.
Last month Belgium and Spain took a first step towards solving a diplomatic row on extradition when they agreed to improve cooperation in the fight against terrorism and organised crime.
The two countries came to diplomatic blows in February when Spain broke off judicial relations following a Belgian court's refusal to extradite two alleged Basque separatist activists.
"I am happy that the misunderstandings are now solved," Dehaene said, without referring specifically to the case.
The Belgian premier was scheduled to have a private meeting with Aznar at the Moncloa presidential complex on Monday night, followed by a dinner in his honour.
